items.q: Which process moves water vapour from plants into the air?
items.qAf: Watter proses beweeg waterdamp vanaf plante na die lug?
items.explain: Transpiration releases water vapour from plant leaves into the air.
items.explainAf: Transpirasie stel waterdamp uit plantblare in die lug vry.

items.qAf: Verdamping word die beste beskryf as:
options: liquid turning into gas at the surface
optionsAf: vloeistof wat by die oppervlak in gas verander
items.explain: Evaporation is the change of state from liquid to gas at the surface.
items.explainAf: Verdamping is die toestandsverandering van vloeistof na gas by die oppervlak.

items.q: Most of Earth's water is found in:
items.qAf: Die meeste van die aarde se water is in:
items.explain: Oceans and seas hold about 96% of Earth's water.
items.explainAf: Oseane en seë hou ongeveer 96% van die aarde se water.

items.q: Water is 'hard' when it contains high levels of:
items.qAf: Water is ‘hard’ wanneer dit hoë vlakke van die volgende bevat:
items.explain: Calcium and magnesium ions make water hard.
items.explainAf: Kalsium- en magnesiumione maak water hard.

items.q: Eutrophication in a dam is mainly caused by:
items.qAf: Eutrofiëring in ’n dam word hoofsaaklik veroorsaak deur:
options: too many nutrients, such as fertiliser
items.explain: Excess nutrients make algae grow rapidly, which later depletes the oxygen in the water.
items.explainAf: Oormaat voedingstowwe laat alge vinnig groei, wat later die suurstof in die water uitput.

items.qAf: ’n Watermonster het ’n pH van 3. Hierdie water is:
